findings.title: The approved scope-addendum authority denial matrix is not fully tested
findings.reproduction: At exact candidate 8b64f8d194f798de697228d36c6ec984dc6b7f57, inspect tests/foundation/test_recoveryctl.py lines 1280-1357 or run `rg -n "approved_b01_scope_addendum_paths" tests/foundation/test_recoveryctl.py`. The only addendum-specific test proves the valid exact path union, rejects the installed base as non-strict, returns no extension for GRR-0001.S01, rejects one altered approval byte sequence through the immutable-blob guard, and rejects one missing approval as a partial chain. It never constructs the approved packet's separately required stale-authority, forked-authority, self-reviewed-addendum, wrong-canonical-path, extra-approved-path, explicit-unapproved-status, or sibling/wrong-candidate cases. Other tests cover general supplement reviewer independence, stale submission state, and witness workspace deviations, but they do not call the addendum loader with those authority mutations. This contradicts the scope-addendum verification obligation to test every named denial and leaves original S01 acceptance criterion 7's authority/scope verification incomplete, while GRR-0002.B01.evidence.json claims the exact 25-test suite covers that surface.
